📖 How this report works

What it shows

The purchase order lines that should have arrived by now: every line whose scheduled fulfillment date has passed and that is not yet fully received, with what was ordered, what has come in and what is still backordered. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Backorder Report and reads the same data the same way.

Which lines

Purchase and misc. purchase lines that are Entered or Partial, on POs past Bid Request, for inventory, non-inventory, capital equipment, shipping and misc parts (or a misc. purchase with no part). Fulfilled, closed short and voided lines never show.

The date range picks lines by the day they were due. It starts on This month, as the standard report does; choose All dates to see every overdue line.

A line received in full stays open until its receipt is fulfilled, so it shows with 0 backordered, as in the standard report. Tick Leave out lines received in full to hide those.

Using it
  • Filter changes apply straight away. Choosing no vendors or location groups means all of them. Group by lists the lines by vendor, by part or by PO.
  • More columns adds what the standard report doesn't print: days late, the unit cost and the backordered value (home currency), the vendor's part number, the PO's own scheduled date, when the line last had something received, and the PO's location group.
  • Click a group's row to show or hide its lines; Expand / Collapse do every group. Click a vendor, part or PO to open it in Fishbowl.
  • Opened from the Vendor module, the report starts on that vendor; change the Vendors filter to see others.
  • Click a column heading to sort the lines within each group (again to reverse, a third time for the standard order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • The Table / Pivot selector switches to a pivot: the backordered value, the backordered, ordered or received qty, days late, the number of lines or of POs by any two of vendor, part, PO, location group, UOM, Overdue by (weeks late: 0–1, 1–2, 2–4, 4–8, 8–13, 13+; a line 8 days late is in 1–2 weeks) and the scheduled date. It opens on value by vendor and weeks late. Click a figure to see the lines behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 or so lines (whole groups) with a Load all button; the counts then cover the lines shown.
